notes: Event date: 10 October 1944 (de Jong, Het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden in de Tweede Wereldoorlog, deel 10a, p. 768). Event definition: A first company of the Stoottroepen (just over 120 men) under Sjef de Groot goes in English lorries to the Land van Maas en Waal, which was being raided by German patrols crossing the Waal; they are committed along the dike between Leeuwen and Wamel. Two further companies were later added to this first company on the Waal (p. 768-769).
